summary: This audit reviewed 24 key details from Brendan Dassey's three recorded interrogations (Feb 27, Mar 1, May 13, 2006). Investigators were the first source for 10 details (three partially), four details were already public, one may trace to an unrecorded statement, and nine details appear first from the suspect in the available record. Multiple details were adopted by the suspect only after leading questions, and interrogation transcripts show high interrogator control and extensive use of fact-carrying questions. Two details evolved across sessions, and one investigator-raised detail was never adopted.
key_points: Investigators introduced 10 of 24 key details first (3 in part), e.g., vehicle in Avery's garage (MCSD p. 548), knife (MHS p. 460), shot in head (MCSD p. 587), shot in garage (MCSD p. 594), phone/camera/purse burned (SCSD p. 817).

Nine details appear first from the suspect in the record, e.g., tied with rope (MHS p. 471), body in RAV4 (MCSD p. 550), restrained on bed (MCSD p. 566), stabbed in stomach (MHS p. 469), strangled (MCSD p. 579), hair cut (MCSD p. 584), throat cut (MCSD p. 586), RAV4 hidden in salvage yard (MHS p. 459), bedsheets burned (MCSD p. 607).

Four details were public before interviews: body burned (Nov 16, 2005), license plates removed (Nov 16, 2005), vehicle key in bedroom (Nov 10, 2005), clothes burned (Nov 16, 2005); investigators also mentioned them before the suspect (MHS p. 442, MCSD p. 601, MCSD p. 602, MHS p. 456).

Seven details were adopted only after agreeing to investigator questions: vehicle in garage (MCSD p. 548), knife (MHS p. 463), license plates (MCSD p. 602), Avery raised hood (MCSD p. 603), bleach on jeans (MCSD p. 527), blood on garage floor (MCSD p. 547), clothes burned (MHS p. 471).
Interrogation dynamics: interrogator spoke 87.5% of words in first session; 742 fact-carrying questions across sessions; tactics include 'we already know' (52), minimization (30), demand truth (85).

Two details evolved across sessions: .22 rifle (investigators: 'gun' at MHS p. 464; suspect added '22' at MCSD p. 587) and bones/shovel (investigators: 'bones' at MHS p. 443; suspect added 'break/shovel' at MCSD p. 637). Tattoo on stomach raised but never adopted (MCSD p. 662).
limits: Audit limited to public transcripts; unrecorded sessions (Two Rivers PD on Feb 27, evening with Fassbender) not examined.
Cannot determine truthfulness, independent knowledge, or whether suspect-first details derived from unrecorded suggestions.
Does not assess voluntariness, coercion, or legal admissibility of statements.
Origin coding rules (e.g., partial investigator mention counts as investigator-first) may affect detail attribution.
